storyCards.headline: New Year's Day: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
U2's "New Year's Day" reached #53 on the Billboard Hot 100. It is the third track on their 1983 album War and was released as the album's lead single in January 1983.

The song peaked at #53 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 12 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "The Best Of 1980-1990/The B-Sides" (1998) — not the song's original release year.

Album: The Best Of 1980-1990/The B-Sides (1998).

Chart story — peaked at #53 on the Hot 100.
